concepts.description: A modular unit that encapsulates the AUV system components and architecture.
A physical or simulated robotic platform that interacts with sensors and actuators within the AUV system.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate and exchange data or events.
A control unit within the AUV system responsible for managing operations and processing inputs/outputs.
A basic data type defined within the AUV_Module to represent fundamental value categories.
A structured data type defined within AUV_Module that groups multiple named values of possibly different types.
A named data field within an Interface that holds a specific type of data accessible to components using that Interface.
A named signal or callable action defined within an Interface that can be triggered by components, optionally taking parameters and returning a value.
A named computational unit defined within AUV_Module that takes inputs and returns a computed output value.

instances.description: The top-level module that encapsulates the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system, using the Interfaces Sensors and Actuators defined by AUV_Module.
An Interface used by AUV_Platform to receive sensor data, defined by AUV_Module.
An Interface used by AUV_Platform to control actuators, defined by AUV_Module.
A Controller within AUV_Module that manages operator-level control, using the Interface Inputs.
An Interface used by AUV_Operator and other controllers to receive input commands, defined by AUV_Module.
A Controller within AUV_Module representing the Last Response Engine, using the Interfaces Inputs and Outputs.
An Interface used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands, defined by AUV_Module.
A Controller within AUV_Module responsible for autonomous piloting, using the Interface Outputs.
A Primitive Type representing natural numbers, defined by AUV_Module.
A Primitive Type representing integer numbers, defined by AUV_Module.
A Primitive Type representing string values, defined by AUV_Module.
A Primitive Type representing boolean values, defined by AUV_Module.
A Primitive Type representing real numbers, defined by AUV_Module.
A Composite Type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A Composite Type representing an obstacle detected by the AUV, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng.
A Value in the Sensors Interface representing the depth measurement of the AUV, of type real.
A Value in the Sensors Interface representing the heading of the AUV, of type SVec.
A Value in the Sensors Interface representing an obstacle detected by the AUV, of type Obstacle.
An Interface defined by AUV_Module for receiving input commands and requests, containing events endTask, reqOCM, reqMOM, reqHCM, reqVel, and reqHdng.
An Event in the Intpus Interface that signals the end of a task, with no Parameters and no Return Value.
An Event in the Intpus Interface that requests an Obstacle Collision Manoeuvre, with no Parameters and no Return Value.
An Event in the Intpus Interface that requests a Mission Override Manoeuvre, with no Parameters and no Return Value.
An Event in the Intpus Interface that requests a Heading Change Manoeuvre, with no Parameters and no Return Value.
An Event in the Intpus Interface that requests the current velocity, with no Parameters and a Return Value of type real.
An Event in the Intpus Interface that requests the current heading, with no Parameters and a Return Value of type real.
An Event in the Outputs Interface that advises a velocity value, taking one Parameter of type real and no Return Value.
An Event in the Outputs Interface that advises a heading value, taking one Parameter of type real and no Return Value.
A Composite Type representing a close-distance alert, recording horiz_cda and vert_cda of type real, and id of type nat.
A Function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the overall distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A Function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A Function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
